positions.name: MeridianDeploymentGatePolicy
positions.frame: what governs Meridian deployments — the signed-manifest requirement, where it applies, and who is accountable for it?
positions.why: src-1 declares the requirement in prose ('now requires a signed release manifest before it ships'); src-3 and src-4 restate the same requirement and its environmental scope in compressed gate-spec form; src-5 assigns the accountable owner. All four read in the same direction — settled, ratified facets (rule, restatement, scope, ownership) of one deployment-gate policy, each performed with decision-level conviction ('now requires', bolded gate/scope/owner labels) rather than argued for. src-2 is held apart: it supplies the causal justification for the gate (the incident that motivated it) but functions as support for the policy rather than as a facet of what the policy itself specifies, so it is left out of this set.
